name: Aristotle Central Pipeline

values.StartLocation: Socrates North power plant, New Albany
values.EndLocation: Socrates South power plant, New Albany

researcher_notes: Not in the GEM gas roster under any name. The sibling Aristotle South and Aristotle North lines are separate candidates. The Ohio Power Siting Board 2025 annual report lists an accelerated letter of notification, case 25-0847-GA-BLN, titled Aristotle Central Pipeline Project, which is the concrete filing step. The Williams Socrates page lists Aristotle Central among the Will-Power Pipeline OH and Will-Power OH siting cases, with target in-service in the second half of 2026. Length, size, endpoints and proposed status come from the Oil and Gas Watch record, read through the site's data record because the page itself is a JavaScript shell and the verifier cannot read it. It says a proposed 9.4-mile, 24-inch line in Licking County linking the Socrates North and Socrates South plants in New Albany, then joining the Aristotle South Pipeline. That is one source for the length, so the tier is medium. The siting board filing itself was not loadable, and it would confirm length and dates. Owner is the pipeline subsidiary named on the Williams page. Data center tie: the Williams Socrates project page presents the Socrates facilities, Aristotle Central among them, as Williams serving the data center market. The Pipeline and Gas Journal item of June 2025 (a Reuters report) says the Socrates South plant serves a Meta-affiliated data center. This line links the two Socrates plants, so DataCenter is yes on the same basis as the Aristotle South Pipeline, at medium confidence because no page names this line together with Meta. Route: Oil and Gas Watch has a low-resolution digitized trace taken from the siting board application, but no official map was found, so route stays unavailable until the filing map is read.
